title: VoiceNodeHealth
description: Leased etcd value at /discordy/voice/health/<node_id>. A writer must atomically compare both the node registration lease and its exclusive /discordy/voice/probers/<node_id> claim before writing. The health value shares the prober claim's lease, expiring within two probe intervals if not renewed. Readers match registration_lease; a previous incarnation's result must never authorize or exclude its successor.

status.description: Unknown until M consecutive passes or N consecutive failures. Defaults N=2, M=2. A healthy node survives fewer than N failures; an unhealthy node remains excluded until M passes.

checked_at_ms.description: Unix time for diagnostics only; freshness follows the etcd lease, not synchronized wall clocks.
